comment_regular: Shared Oblivion console execute routine for AdvSkill/AdvancePCSkill and ModPCSkill. It raises the base skill and manually increments skill, specialization, governing-attribute, and major counters. Unlike Player_SkillLevelIncrease, it never calls Player_MaybeStartNextAttributeBonusBucket, so repeated command-driven major advances do not perform normal attribute-bucket rollover.
